staticPages.lore:
“This book is bound to your soul. Every block you mine, every chest you plunder, every life you extinguish… it leaves a stain.

When your stains run deep, the sky shall tear open and the Void will demand its tribute. You cannot run. You cannot hide. You can only survive.”
staticPages.rulesPart1:
§0§lHow the Gauntlet Works§r

§4• The Sin Meter:§r Your actions accrue Sin. When your meter hits 100, your current judge is summoned.

§4• The Gauntlet:§r You must face all 14 legendary executioners in order.
staticPages.rulesPart2:
§4• The Toll:§r If you fall in the arena, your progression halts. You will face the same Judge again when you next transgress.

If you succeed, you earn a piece of your shattered self.

callToJudgement.flavorText: “Do not wait for the Void to drag you kicking and screaming. Prove your defiance. When your sin is ripe, open this page and command the gate to open.”
